description: This file is a shell script named deptest.sh, used for automating package dependency testing in an OpenWrt build environment. It includes functions for building packages, cleaning build directories, handling stamps, and managing test workflows. The script also manages command-line options for different testing modes.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs the make command with specified targets and logs output.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Cleans the kernel build directory, preserving the main kernel directory.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file or link exists.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Tests a specific package for build success, handling stamps and logs.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Runs a target make command for bootstrap operations related to deptest.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Runs a native bootstrap make command for essential tools and dependencies.
